description: Unofficial Wendy fan art from Don’t Starve, in her white blouse and red pleated skirt, adapted with opaque leggings and a modest knee-length hem. Original gentle animations include flower-vase adjustments, blank booklet and petal handling, quiet weight shifts and blinks, a crescent-paper walk, a small hop and true steps in three directions. No ghost companion or frightening harm.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
